def blind_reader(conv_name, bn_prefix, u, m0, alpha=1.0, base='original'):
    """Make a 1x1 conv reader blind to direction u of its input (mean-ablation to neutral point m0).
       W' = W - alpha*(W u) u^T ; bn.running_mean' = rm - alpha*(W u)(u.m0)"""
    ld = load_original if base=='original' else load

    u_t = torch.tensor(u, dtype=torch.float64);

    Wn = Wc.clone(); Wn[:,:,0,0] = Wc[:,:,0,0] - alpha*torch.outer(Wu, u_t)
    rm = ld(bn_prefix+'.running_mean').double()
    rmn = rm - alpha*Wu*float(u@m0)
    save_edit(conv_name, Wn.float()); save_edit(bn_prefix+'.running_mean', rmn.float())
    return float(Wu.norm()), float(Wc[:,:,0,0].norm()), float(u@m0)
